description: Expo (React Native) app for the TCG card portfolio, scanning, social feed, and trading platform — iOS, Android, and web from one codebase.

features.notes: DONE 2026-08-04 (human-directed close) -- 31/31 in-scope tasks [X], 181 tests passing, ./init.sh RESULT: SUCCESS (10/10 stages incl. the new iOS/Android bundle exports), tsc clean. Ships: personal + Tienda registration, phone verification with SMS autofill variants, the profile step (typed CURP/RFC fields per the re-scope), the KYC status gate, and the first-run tutorial. FOUR remaining tasks were MOVED OUT to 003-registration-kyc-completion rather than dropped: T021 (manual smoke -- web blocked on backend 006-web-cors, iOS partially verified), T022/T023 (US3 session persistence, deferred to backend 004-session-authentication), T035 (real tutorial endpoints, now that backend 002-onboarding-tutorial-state shipped them). CAVEATS THE HUMAN SHOULD KNOW BEFORE MERGING: (a) code-reviewer's second review returned CHANGES_REQUESTED on a blocking finding (setCurrentUserId never called -> every /identity/me/* and /phone/* call would 401); that was fixed as T033, but T033 and T034 landed AFTER that review and have NOT been re-reviewed by code-reviewer. (b) The end-to-end flow has never been run green against a live backend: web is blocked by the backend's missing CORS (registered there as 006-web-cors), and the happy path additionally needs real EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY plus the backend pointed at the same Supabase project (it currently runs AUTH_PROVIDER_MODE=mock, which creates a fake authProviderId the client cannot sign in against). Registration itself IS confirmed working against the real backend (HTTP 201 via curl and from the iOS simulator). (c) Four 'green tests, broken app' bugs were found by manual/real-backend testing that the test suite did not catch (T031 no session ever established, T033 X-User-Id never set, T034 unhandled sign-in rejection, plus an ExpoLinking native-module mismatch) -- treat 181 passing tests as necessary, not sufficient. PRIOR HISTORY -- RE-SCOPED 2026-08-04 (T001-T003 already [X], implementation resumed at new T004). task-implementer's mandatory backend cross-check during T001-T003 found the approved spec/plan/tasks targeted a backend scope that no longer exists: (1) backend descoped ALL KYC document handling out of its 001 into 002-kyc-document-verification (pending, unspec'd) on 2026-08-03 -- no presign endpoint, no object storage, no KYC provider; (2) backend has no path off kycStatus: pending at all (FR-006: KYC gates money paths only, not implemented here); (3) real backend flow is 3 calls -- POST /identity/register(/business) (email/password/phone/username only) -> POST /identity/phone/verify -> POST /identity/me/profile (nombre/apellidoPaterno/apellidoMaterno?/birthDate/nationality/curp/rfc as typed fields + ToS/privacy), not the assumed 2-step doc-upload flow; (4) business fields (commercialName/rfc/fiscalAddress) belong at the profile step, not registration. Orchestrator independently re-verified all findings against the backend's specs/001-user-registration-kyc/spec.md, prisma/schema.prisma, and feature_list.json (backend 001 is done, 117 tests). Human re-scope decisions encoded 2026-08-04: (A) document upload moved out to new frontend feature 002-kyc-document-verification (registered below, pending, blocked on backend 002 being spec'd); (B) kycStatus: pending now passes through to the main app (resolveKycRoute/KycStatusScreen stay, but only route to kyc-status on rejected or a fetch-failure -- rejected is unreachable against the current backend, built-and-tested via mocked fixtures, not dead code); (C) added a profile-step screen gated behind phone verification. spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md all amended accordingly; FR-004 rewritten (typed profile fields, was documents), FR-009 rewritten (routing gate matrix, decision B), original document-related FR-004/FR-008/SC-004/AS/platform-notes/edge-cases preserved verbatim under each file's 'Deferred to feature 002' section. tasks.md: T001-T003 stay [X] with unchanged numbering; new T004/T005 are follow-ups to already-completed T002 (remove IdentityDocument -- moved to 002, not kept as forward declaration; add backend-mirroring User fields) and T003 (widen resolveKycRoute's route union/branches per decision B) respectively; former T005/T006/T014/T015/T016/T017 (presign/upload/confirm, camera-upload adapter, permission screen, doc-upload screens) relocated verbatim to a 'Deferred to feature 002' section at the bottom of tasks.md. Also notes an unresolved constraint (not solved by this feature): backend /identity/me/* and /identity/phone/* authenticate via a dev-only X-User-Id header until backend 003-session-authentication (pending) ships -- recorded in spec.md Assumptions, affects US3 and every authenticated call. See progress/current.md for the full session log.

Registered 2026-08-04 as part of re-scoping 001-registration-kyc: KYC document upload (official ID + proof of life capture, presign->PUT->confirm upload flow, the pre-permission explanation screen, camera-permission/offline-retry edge cases) was moved out of 001 into this feature, mirroring the same split already made on the backend (backend's KYC-document feature, RENUMBERED to 003-kyc-document-verification as of 2026-08-04 -- the backend inserted 002-onboarding-tutorial-state ahead of it, so every 'backend 002' reference written earlier in this repo means backend 003; still pending/unspec'd). No spec.md written yet -- deliberately not spec'd until the backend's own 003 is spec'd first, since this feature's contract (endpoints, field names, kycStatus transition mechanics) has no backend counterpart to mirror yet. All the original 001 requirements/acceptance-scenarios/platform-notes/edge-cases/tasks this feature should start from are preserved verbatim in specs/001-registration-kyc/spec.md's and tasks.md's 'Deferred to feature 002' sections -- read those first. Also owns: kycStatus transitions away from pending (verified/rejected), enforcement of the money-path KYC gate (sale/withdrawal only, not card-for-card trades, per backend FR-006), and whatever CTA destination 001's KycStatusScreen's 'Resubmit documents' placeholder route should eventually point to.

Created 2026-08-04 to hold the four tasks that were still open when 001-registration-kyc was closed at the human's direction. These are NOT abandoned work -- each is carried over verbatim, with its full context, in specs/001-registration-kyc/tasks.md's 'Moved to feature 003' section; read that first, it is the source of truth for scope. Contents: (1) T035 -- switch tutorial completion from local-only expo-secure-store to the real GET /identity/me/tutorials + POST /identity/me/tutorials/complete, which the backend's 002-onboarding-tutorial-state shipped on 2026-08-04. This is a genuine FR-007 correctness fix, not cleanup: local-only completion is lost on reinstall and does not follow a user across devices, so the tutorial replays for a user who has already seen it, meeting 'once per install' but not FR-007's 'once per user'. THE ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR NOT BLOCKED ON ANYTHING EXTERNAL -- start here. (2) T022/T023 -- US3 session persistence, deferred by human decision on 2026-08-04 because it cannot work until the backend's 004-session-authentication ships: the backend has no full-profile GET (only GET /me/kyc-status, returning { kycStatus } alone), and X-User-Id is in-memory only, so every cold boot fails the status fetch and lands on FR-010's retry screen. BLOCKED on backend 004. (3) T021 -- the manual smoke check 001 never completed. Web is BLOCKED on the backend's missing CORS (tracked there as 006-web-cors); iOS is partially verified (register screen confirmed against the live backend, HTTP 201) but the happy path additionally needs real EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY and the backend moved off AUTH_PROVIDER_MODE=mock onto the same Supabase project. Android was never exercised -- no Android SDK on the dev machine as of 2026-08-04. Also worth folding in here: a code-reviewer pass over 001's T033/T034, which landed after the last review and were never re-reviewed. No spec.md written yet.

DONE 2026-08-05 -- all 22/22 tasks [X], reviewed batch-by-batch by code-reviewer (final verdict APPROVE WITH NITS), ./init.sh RESULT: SUCCESS (10/10 stages, only the pre-existing expo-doctor/native-dep-alignment warnings that predate this feature), 233/233 tests passing, tsc clean. Ships: the persistent nav shell (native <Tabs> on iOS/Android, responsive sidebar>=768px/bottom-bar<768px on web via the .web.tsx convention), the Home/Scan screen (top-left Amigos quick-access pill, top-right four inert placeholder controls, centre '+' card), the /scan and Amigos/Social placeholder route boundaries, and app/index.tsx's removal in favor of app/(app)/index.tsx as 001-registration-kyc's 'main' gate destination. FR-009 held throughout -- zero diff to resolveKycRoute()/useKycGate()/KYC_ROUTE_TARGETS/app/_layout.tsx, independently re-confirmed at every review round including the final one. FR-010 held -- zero backend calls anywhere in this feature's files, independently grepped at the final review. VERIFICATION, PRECISELY STATED (per this repo's own 'green tests, broken app' history -- do not overstate): web was exercised extensively and repeatedly against a REAL running `npm run web` dev server via headless Chrome driven over raw CDP (real DOM reads, real keyboard Tab-order walks, real OS-level window resizes proving no-reload, real click-throughs) at nearly every task, not just Jest/RNTL. A real iOS Simulator (booted iPhone 17 Pro, and for T020/T021 also iPad Pro 13-inch) was used with real Expo Go installs and real device screenshots at T015 and T020/T021 -- this caught and fixed two genuine runtime-only bugs neither type-check nor the web export could have caught: (1) a landscape-viewport card-clipping bug (root View->ScrollView fix in HomeScreen.tsx -- DISCLOSED DESIGN DEVIATION, human-confirmed 2026-08-04 at an escalation gate: the fix scrolls the WHOLE screen rather than just the top-right control stack as spec.md's Edge Cases section originally, illustratively suggested; spec.md's Edge Cases section has been amended by the human directly to state the requirement as the outcome rather than the original illustrative mechanism); (2) an iOS status-bar/Dynamic-Island overlap (useSafeAreaInsets() fix, react-native-safe-area-context was already a dependency but had never actually been called anywhere in the codebase before this). ONE GENUINE OPEN GAP FROM T015, DISCLOSED, NEVER CONCLUSIVELY RESOLVED: reaching Amigos/Social ON NATIVE during manual verification used Expo Go's cold deep-link mechanism as a substitute for a real tap (no Accessibility/UI-automation permission was available in the sandbox to simulate an actual tap); one resulting screenshot showed the native tab bar not visible on the Amigos screen reached that way -- NOT reproduced via a real tap, NOT attributed conclusively to either a real app bug or a deep-link artifact. Recommend a human with real device access specifically check: does tapping the Amigos tab from a warm Home screen keep the tab bar visible on the Amigos screen? T019 (top-right controls' manual a11y pass) was WEB-ONLY -- no simulator booted for that task, no real VoiceOver/TalkBack session was ever run at any point in this feature, disclosed honestly rather than assumed covered. ANDROID WAS NEVER AVAILABLE IN THIS ENVIRONMENT AT ANY POINT -- no emulator/SDK, zero Android-specific manual verification was performed for this entire feature (inferred-safe via no .android.tsx files and cross-platform-only RN primitives used, but never actually checked). ONE ACKNOWLEDGED, ACCEPTED, NON-BLOCKING LOOSE END surfaced three times across review rounds and explicitly flagged again at the final gate, recorded here per code-reviewer's request rather than silently dropped a fourth time: WebSidebarNav/WebBottomBarNav (T010/T011) each wrap their own independent expo-router <Slot/>, so app/(app)/_layout.web.tsx's sidebar<->bottom-bar switch on a breakpoint crossing unmounts/remounts the active screen subtree, silently resetting any of that screen's local component state (concretely: TopRightControls' 'Not yet available' toggle resets on a resize-triggered layout switch). This does NOT violate spec.md's binding AS6 ('without losing the active destination') since the active ROUTE survives (it lives in expo-router's context above this layout) -- only ephemeral UI feedback state resets, no data/navigation loss. tasks.md's T012 own descriptive text ('without unmounting/remounting the active screen's state') is not literally true of what shipped; low real-world severity, orchestrator-acknowledged here as the explicit sign-off code-reviewer asked for, not fixed in this feature -- a candidate for a small follow-up (hoist a single shared <Slot/> above the layout ternary) if it's ever judged worth the churn. See progress/history.md for the full session log. PRIOR notes (spec-writer's pre-implementation summary) preserved below. spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md written 2026-08-04 by spec-writer -- zero blocking [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers, so NOT blocked. ONE open design decision recorded with a chosen default instead of a blocking marker, per the human's own framing ('so the human can decide at the approval gate'): the web nav treatment (spec.md Clarifications) defaults to Option C -- persistent left sidebar >=768px, native-equivalent bottom bar below -- flagged explicitly for the human to confirm or override when reviewing this feature; every other artifact is written so only that one line item would need to change if overridden. Also resolved (non-blocking, a reasonable default exists): the wireframe's top-left 'Amigos' pill navigates to the same Amigos destination as the shell's Amigos tab rather than a second competing entry point (FR-008) -- flagged in spec.md's Design note in case the human intended something else. Scope confirmed against feature_list.json's original request notes (preserved below) plus AGENTS.md/constitution.md/docs/conventions.md/docs/verification.md/specs/001-registration-kyc's pattern: 4 user stories (P1 shell+landing, P1 '+' -> scanner-stub navigation, P2 Amigos/Social reachability, P3 top-right inert controls), 22 tasks, zero backend calls (explicit in spec.md and plan.md -- this is pure UI-shell work, no Draw-a-card backend counterpart to check against). Integration point verified: 001's resolveKycRoute()/useKycGate()/KYC_ROUTE_TARGETS are read-only dependencies here (FR-009) -- this feature only replaces what the existing 'main' route renders (app/index.tsx's scaffold placeholder -> app/(app)/index.tsx inside a new tab/shell route group), does not touch the gate itself. No new runtime dependency needed (plan.md Research Decisions: @react-navigation/bottom-tabs already ships transitively with the installed expo-router, @expo/vector-icons already ships transitively with expo) -- confirmed against node_modules directly, not assumed. Constitution Principle V exception documented and justified in plan.md's Constitution Check: new src/features/navigation/ module has no backend bounded context to mirror (it's the cross-cutting shell chrome), while the scanner-entry card/stub and Amigos/Social placeholders correctly reuse the existing src/features/scanner/ and src/features/social/ scaffolds. ORIGINAL REQUEST (verbatim, preserved for reference): Wireframe contents, top to bottom: (a) top-left a pill-shaped 'Amigos' button; (b) top-right a vertical stack of four small controls, labelled in the sketch as 'ENG/ESP', 'USD/MXN', 'Notifications', 'Messages'; (c) dead-centre a large vertically-oriented rounded rectangle (card aspect ratio) containing a single '+' glyph; (d) along the bottom edge a wide rounded bar labelled 'social'. IN SCOPE: the persistent navigation shell containing three destinations -- Amigos, the centre Scan/home screen, and Social -- rendered as a BOTTOM TAB BAR on iOS/Android and, per the human's explicit instruction, as a modern web-appropriate navigation on web (the human said 'for web try to implement it in a modern way' -- treat the exact web treatment as a design decision for the spec to settle and clarify with the human if genuinely ambiguous, but it must satisfy constitution Principle VII responsiveness/keyboard-nav and Principle IV's rule that the platform split uses the .web.tsx convention rather than inline Platform conditionals); the centre home screen itself with the card-shaped '+' affordance; and the four top-right controls. OUT OF SCOPE (explicit human instruction -- 'ignore the amigos and social but add the tab'): any Amigos or Social screen content. Those two destinations get reachable placeholder screens only. ALSO OUT OF SCOPE: the scanner itself -- the human stated it is 'another feature'. The '+' card is an affordance that NAVIGATES to the scanner route; this feature defines and wires that route boundary and may stub the destination, but implements no camera, no capture, no recognition. The four top-right controls are PLACEHOLDERS TOO: render them with correct affordance, position, accessibility labels and tap targets, but no language switching, no currency conversion, no notification feed, no messaging -- each is a no-op or a stub destination. Note the language and currency controls imply future i18n (ENG/ESP) and multi-currency (USD/MXN) features that do not exist yet; the spec should record them as forward dependencies, not build them. INTEGRATION POINT: app/index.tsx is still the scaffold placeholder from repo setup, and 001-registration-kyc's routing gate (src/features/identity resolveKycRoute) already routes a verified user to the app root -- so this feature is what that gate lands on. Check how 001 wires the post-KYC landing before changing routing.
